HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANISH DAYAL  ORDER % 21.03.2023 CRL.M.A. 7438/2023(Exemption)
1. Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. Application is disposed of .

1. This petition has been filed for quashing of FIR No. 378/2020 registered at Patel Nagar under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC on the ground that the parties have settled their disputes which is evident from the order dated 23rd January, 2023 passed by the Division Bench of this Court.

The terms of the settlement were recorded in the said order by Division Bench of this Court, as per which an amount of Rs. 50 lacs has already been paid to the respondent No.2 (complainant) and balance amount of Rs. 10 lacs has been given vide post cheque dated 23rd January, 2024.
The respondent No. 2 who appears through VC confirms receipt of Rs.50 lacs and of the said PDC.
Petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2 were married on 30.11.2017 but due to disputes and differences the marriage ended in divorce vide decree dated 21st February, 2023.
No child was born out of wedlock.
2. Since the petitioner No.1 has drawn the post dated cheque for Rs. 10 lacs, his undertaking is being recorded that the said cheque will be honoured when presented by the respondent No.2.
Any violation of the undertaking will amount to contempt of this Court.

3. Considering the above settlement between the parties and the chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use continuing with proceedings of the present FIR as it would be a misuse of the process of the Court and an unnecessary burden on the State exchequer.
Accordingly, the petition is allowed.
Consequently, the FIR No. 378/2020 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC registered at PS Patel Nagar and proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
